source: Do not delete temporary files unless the extraction process has successfully completed with exit code 0.
allowed_variations: 除非解压进程已以退出代码 0 成功完成，否则切勿删除临时文件
在解压成功完成前不要删除临时文件
key_semantics: 条件与否定：禁止在成功退出前删除文件（语义绝对不得反转为‘应删除临时文件’）

source: This feature is not supported in version 1.2 or earlier; upgrade to at least 2.0 before enabling it.
allowed_variations: 此特性在 1.2 及更早版本中不受支持
启用前请先升级到至少 2.0 版本
key_semantics: 版本限制与否定：早期版本不支持，必须升级到 2.0+

source: Never commit API keys or unencrypted passwords into source control repositories.
allowed_variations: 切勿将 API 密钥或未加密密码提交到代码仓库
严禁将明文凭据纳入源码控制
key_semantics: 绝对否定禁令：禁止提交密钥到仓库

source: The lock will not be released automatically if an unhandled thread abort occurs.
allowed_variations: 若发生未处理的线程中止，锁将不会被自动释放
key_semantics: 条件否定：未处理异常发生时锁不会释放，可能引发死锁

source: Only users with the `Admin` role can modify system settings, provided two-factor authentication is active.
allowed_variations: 仅在双重身份验证处于激活状态的前提下，具备 Admin 角色的用户才能修改系统设置
key_semantics: 充分必要复合条件：双因素认证 + Admin 角色同时满足

source: Clients must not send more than 100 requests per minute unless an explicit enterprise quota is granted.
allowed_variations: 除非获得了显式企业配额授权，否则客户端每分钟发起的请求不得超过 100 次
key_semantics: 速率限制条件禁令：非企业用户不得超限

source: Under no circumstances should the background worker bypass signature verification.
allowed_variations: 在任何情况下，后台工作进程都不得绕过签名验证
key_semantics: 强语气倒装否定：绝对不得跳过签名验证

source: If and only if the handshake packet contains a valid nonce will the server allocate session memory.
allowed_variations: 当且仅当握手数据包包含有效随机数（nonce）时，服务器才会分配会话内存
key_semantics: 充要条件：必须包含有效 nonce 才分配内存

source: Data cannot be restored after clicking 'Confirm Erase'; this operation is permanent and irreversible.
allowed_variations: 点击「确认擦除」后数据无法恢复；此操作具有永久性且不可逆
key_semantics: 不可逆操作与否定警示：擦除后不可恢复

source: Without explicit consent from the user, no outbound network telemetry may be dispatched.
allowed_variations: 未经用户明确同意，不得外发任何网络遥测数据
key_semantics: 隐私保护前置否定：无同意不外发

source: Neither primary nor replica nodes will accept writes during the split-brain arbitration phase.
allowed_variations: 在脑裂仲裁阶段，主节点和副本节点均不接受写入请求
key_semantics: 双重并列否定：主从节点均不接受写操作

source: The cache is invalidated if the revision mismatch flag is raised or if the TTL has expired, but not otherwise.
allowed_variations: 若触发版本不匹配标志或 TTL 已过期，缓存将被失效；除此之外不会失效
key_semantics: 排他性条件：仅两种情况缓存失效，其余保持有效

source: Avoid calling synchronous I/O methods from within the UI dispatcher thread to prevent frame drops.
allowed_variations: 避免在 UI 调度器线程内调用同步 I/O 方法，以防止掉帧卡顿
key_semantics: 操作建议与反面劝阻：不要在 UI 线程执行阻塞 I/O

source: Unless specifically configured otherwise, all outgoing requests default to HTTPS port 443.
allowed_variations: 除非特别另行配置，否则所有出站请求均默认使用 HTTPS 443 端口
key_semantics: 默认值与特例说明：默认走安全 443 端口

source: Do not attempt to decrypt payloads using expired certificates; verification will fail and abort the pipeline.
allowed_variations: 不要尝试使用过期证书解密负载；验证将失败并中止流水线
key_semantics: 禁止行为及确定性失败因果关系
